home.title: My apps
home.empty:
No apps installed.
Connect the reader to Wi-Fi to download the app catalog.
startup.pruned: Home screen entries of apps that no longer exist were taken out: %d (shown when the cable is unplugged).
home.failed:
Could not download the catalog.
Check the Wi-Fi and open the Launcher again.
install.done: “%s” installed. It is now under Installed.
app.state.missing: Not installed. Tap the app to install it.
app.state.update: Installed (version %s). A different build is published (version %s): it can be updated.
app.state.current: Installed (version %s). It is the published build.
app.hidden: “%s” is hidden. Settings > Hidden apps shows it again.
app.shown: “%s” is back on the home screen.
app.remove.title: Remove app
app.remove.ask: Remove “%s” from the reader? This deletes the app, its database and settings, its icons and its entry on the home screen. It cannot be undone.
settings.apps.none: There are no apps to manage.
settings.title: Settings
settings.background.hint: Copy pictures (PNG, JPG, BMP) to the applications/backgrounds folder of the reader to choose one here.
settings.invalid: Type numbers for the columns and the rows.
